description: TsgFEM is MATLAB software for designing and analysing tensegrity structures with finite elements. The JOSS paper describes topology design, statics and dynamics, and the own README discusses structural and control objectives. Spatial coverage is the user-defined tensegrity geometry and temporal coverage is the selected load history. The public repository reports MPL-2.0. Engineers can use it to compare lightweight structural configurations or test response assumptions for engineered components. A caveat is that idealized cables, struts, joints and prestress need calibration before predictions apply to a built structure. The software does not certify building safety, and MATLAB is a separate commercial dependency. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own repository were read without running a tensegrity model. Its static and dynamic outputs can be compared within a structural simulation of a candidate component, with separate material checks.
inputs: Member force densities and material properties
name: TsgFEM tensegrity structures
